What is included

Floe exports your App-owned data locally in one verified package: projects, Notes, chats/tasks, Canvas and media, attachments, Safe preferences and disabled schedule definitions. Nothing is uploaded and no account is required.
Included
Project files
Retained project folders (kept after project deletion)
Notes documents, notebooks and their resources
To export one note as a .floenote package, use Export in the note\'s own menu.
CAD .floecad folders stay directories and are carried file-by-file; preview stays separate.
Chats, tasks, messages, runs, action receipts, todos, retained tool results, memory, checklist revisions, skills and model preferences
Canvas and media documents with their resource files
Generated images, canvas/remote captures, run outputs, job downloads and user capture files
Retained Office recovery working copies, verified exports and previously restored copies (restored as new documents; no live recovery state)
Sanitized provider/model entries and non-secret remote, mail and voice settings (restored disabled or read-only; no credential)
Saved schedules (restored disabled; no alarm is armed)
Read-only action and mail receipts
Safe display/editor preferences
Never included
The following are deliberately excluded, not silently omitted:
Format %1$d (.%2$s). A live app or notes database is never copied.
Raw live database/WAL files and ephemeral session state (typed rows are exported separately)
Notes edit history, trash and assistant threads (documents use the portable format)
API keys and credential values
Device-bound keys
Session secrets and login tokens
Cookies
Approval grants and future permissions
Task run outputs (export them individually from the task)
Chats, runs, send receipts and scheduled paid actions
System calendar, contacts, health and other OS stores (not read)
External/SAF project folders (owned by their provider)
Private task workspaces
Canvas and media projects (separate authority)
Network capture artifacts
Environments, rootfs images and rebuildable caches
Notes trash (count is shown before restore)
